say:3:1460202001:2.text: Magister, her dark magic is too strong!
say:3:1460202001:2.source_cn: 主人，她的黑暗魔法太强了！
say:3:1460202001:2.male: Magister, her dark magic is too strong!
say:3:1460202001:2.female: Magister, her dark magic is too strong!

say:4:1460202002:1.text: The Divine Dew's power is beyond your imagination! Toplanders, your resistance is futile!
say:4:1460202002:1.source_cn: 恩典灵露的力量远超你们想象！地表人，你们的抵抗毫无意义！

say:6:1460202004:1.text: Why not just give up? The Queen will be pleased to see you...
say:6:1460202004:1.source_cn: 别再挣扎了，女王会很高兴见到你们的……

say:7:1460202005:3.text: Especially these two furry little cuties. It's been a long time since I've prepared such special offerings.
say:7:1460202005:3.source_cn: 尤其是这两只毛茸茸的小东西，很久没有如此特别的祭品了。

choice_prompt:8:1460202005.text: Especially these two furry little cuties. It's been a long time since I've prepared such special offerings.
choice_prompt:8:1460202005.source_cn: 尤其是这两只毛茸茸的小东西，很久没有如此特别的祭品了。

say:9:1460202006:1.text: Silence. Now, let me take you to meet...

say:10:1460202007:1.text: Wait, you aren't worthy of meeting the Queen yet! I should lock you up first, then...
say:10:1460202007:1.source_cn: 不不不，你们没有资格！我先把你们锁起来，然后再……

narration:11:1460202008:0.text: A purple ray radiates from the tip of the priestess' staff. As you struggle to fight back, everything around you starts to blur, and your mind descends into darkness.
narration:11:1460202008:0.source_cn: 法杖尖端释放出一道紫色的光线，你们试图抵抗，但意识逐渐...

narration:12:1460202009:0.text: As you drift in and out of consciousness, you faintly feel yourself being dragged through a tunnel, your body scraping against the jagged stone walls...
narration:12:1460202009:0.source_cn: 在昏迷状态中，你隐约感觉自己被拖行在崎岖的矿道上，身体...
narration:12:1460202009:0.male: As you drift in and out of consciousness, you faintly feel yourself being dragged through a tunnel, your body scraping against the jagged stone walls...
narration:12:1460202009:0.female: As you drift in and out of consciousness, you faintly feel yourself being dragged through a tunnel, your body scraping against the jagged stone walls...

narration:13:1460202010:0.text: When you finally come around, you find yourself imprisoned in a heavily guarded zone.
narration:13:1460202010:0.source_cn: 当你终于恢复意识时，你发现自己身处在一个被严密看守的区域。
narration:13:1460202010:0.male: When you finally come around, you find yourself imprisoned in a heavily guarded zone.
narration:13:1460202010:0.female: When you finally come around, you find yourself imprisoned in a heavily guarded zone.

narration:14:1460202011:0.text: The last words you heard echo in your mind. Now, one thing is clear—you have to find a way out immediately!
narration:14:1460202011:0.source_cn: 回忆起昏迷前听到的话语，你们现在只有尽快逃离这一条路！
narration:14:1460202011:0.male: The last words you heard echo in your mind. Now, one thing is clear—you have to find a way out immediately!
narration:14:1460202011:0.female: The last words you heard echo in your mind. Now, one thing is clear—you have to find a way out immediately!
